name: stat_bar
description: A skill bar of the stats screen: a label and a value above a row of segments that fill up. Flashes red above the alert threshold.

config.name: metric
config.label: Metric
config.description: The metric that fills the bar

config.name: segments
config.label: Segments
config.description: The number of segments of the bar

config.name: label
config.label: Label
config.description: The text above the bar, e.g. Stamina. Defaults to the metric name

config.name: hide_label
config.label: Hide Label
config.description: Hides the text above the bar

config.name: value_display
config.label: Value
config.description: The text above the right end of the bar: the value like 45 °C, the value and the max value like 90/120, the percentage of the max value, or nothing

config.name: precision
config.label: Precision
config.description: The number of decimal places. If not set, values of 100 and more have none, smaller values one or two

config.name: min
config.label: Min Value
config.description: The value of an empty bar. Defaults to 0

config.name: max
config.label: Max Value
config.description: The value of a full bar. If not set, percentages and °C use 100 and other metrics their highest recorded value

config.name: font
config.label: Font
config.description: The font of the texts. Defaults to Bahnschrift, which ships with Windows

config.name: font_size
config.label: Font Size
config.description: The font size in pixels. If not set, it follows the height of the widget

config.name: color
config.label: Color
config.description: The color of the texts and the filled segments. Defaults to white

config.name: empty_color
config.label: Empty Color
config.description: The color of the empty segments

config.name: alert_threshold
config.label: Threshold (%)
config.description: Percentage of the max value from which the bar flashes. 0 turns it off. Only percentages, °C and metrics with a max value raise the alert

config.name: alert_color
config.label: Alert Color
config.description: The color of the bar above the threshold. Defaults to red
